skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Freeland Tuneseeker
skins.content: Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics/Freeland Tuneseeker. Made with special materials with function in mind, perfect for meeting your various needs and weathering even the roughest conditions.
skins.quote: The wild hills form the staves, adorned by the notes of Gloompincers rolling helplessly in the wind. Czerny takes out pen and paper, writing down music with nature, believing that he can perfect its work.
